packages.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD (Single Player)
packages.author: Geckomacabre / credited contributors
packages.licence: Review repository and all bundled third-party component licences before managed redistribution
packages.minimumGameBuild: Not specified; verify exact Legacy build
packages.maximumGameBuild: Not specified; verify exact Legacy build
packages.installAdapter: Pinned OIV import + OpenRAGE dry-run/install/uninstall profile adapter; exact group state verified after operation; remaining game-build/gameplay acceptance is manual
packages.restoreStrategy: OpenRAGE exact OIV journal-group uninstall; follow-up oiv list confirms the group is absent; gameplay/file restoration still requires manual acceptance testing
packages.performanceTier: Unknown; upstream reports functional Legacy release, but no 1080p RTX 4050 frame-time/VRAM benchmark
packages.notes: Upstream Legacy install guide describes GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-2.8.2-Legacy.oiv installed through OpenIV Package Installer into the mods folder. Requires Script Hook V and Script Hook V .NET 3.7.0 Nightly 193 or newer, plus OpenIV/ASI Loader setup. Upstream states the HUD is English-only; other game languages can show empty boxes and character switching has reportedly crashed. Features include a GTA VI-inspired HUD, 3D minimap, character switcher, additional gameplay systems and optional loading screens; it is not a full replacement of every title/pause/map/settings screen and it does not supply Jason or Lucia models. The upstream README states some HUD art is sourced from Rockstar's official GTA VI media. Review all rights/licences and do not bundle the OIV or third-party character assets. Pin the upstream archive SHA-256, verify the exact Legacy build and nested OIV manifest, and complete safe install/rollback and RTX 4050 testing before approval. The Hub now checks the documented Legacy loader files (Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET and OpenIV.asi) plus the mods folder before enabling the OIV install button, but this is a file-presence check, not proof of runtime version compatibility. The author specifically requires SHVDN 3.7.0 Nightly 193+ and English game language; the user must confirm both. After OIV install, a narrow reversible Hub adapter copies only ViMinimap.asi and ViPreload.asi from mods to the GTA5.exe root with transaction backups. This does not approve the HUD for general use or prove it works on the installed build. The exact upstream 2.8.2 Legacy OIV release is pinned at SHA-256 72B8FE300BD99978756DEF3711DD5AFE4BD5A3B65BD4AEE9E4C8FDF97F250835 (117,140,655 bytes). The Hub now offers a download/import action that retrieves this exact author-hosted asset and quarantines it in the local research library. Download/import does not install the package. This archive digest is a release-integrity pin, not a malware or rights clearance. The Mod Control Centre now applies this exact package's saved ON/OFF state through OpenRAGE: it derives the uninstall group from the imported OIV manifest metadata, lists journal state, performs a fresh dry-run and SHA-256 check before install, and verifies the exact group after install/uninstall. Only this exact pinned HUD package has a profile apply adapter; other selected catalogue entries block Apply. OpenRAGE handles the OIV's loose root ASI operations, so the Hub does not duplicate-copy ViMinimap.asi or ViPreload.asi.
externalRequirements: Script Hook V .NET 3.7.0 Nightly 193 or newer
OpenIV with ASI Loader and OpenIV.asi
GTA V language set to English
Optional: separately sourced compatible Jason and/or Lucia character model (not included)
